079.csv::263.source_text:
最奥、《聖滝の間》に入るには
《水流制御室》で滝を止める必要がある――
079.csv::263.translated_text:
To enter the innermost area, &quot;Holy Waterfall
Hall,&quot; you need to stop the waterfall in the
&quot;Flow Control Room&quot;.
079.csv::263.speaker: Klaus

079.csv::264.source_text:
問題は&quot;失われた鍵&quot;の所在――
鍵がなければ、制御室へ入れないのだ
079.csv::264.translated_text:
The problem is the location of the &quot;lost
key.&quot; Without the key, there is no way to
get into the control room.
079.csv::264.speaker: Klaus

079.csv::270.source_text:
魔物が湧き出てこないよう
正面門に通じる扉は封鎖しておこう
近くに開閉用のレバーがあったはずだ
079.csv::270.translated_text:
To prevent monsters from emerging, we&#x27;ve
blocked the door leading to
the main entrance.
There should be a lever nearby for
opening and closing it.
079.csv::270.speaker: Klaus

079.csv::272.source_text:
――ここにも無いとなれば
この階段を登った先、２階に違いない！
079.csv::272.translated_text:
If it&#x27;s not here either, it must be on the
second floor at the top of these stairs!
079.csv::272.speaker: Joseph

079.csv::275.source_text:
部屋の前までは鍵を持っていたはずだが
通路の宝箱に手を伸ばしたときに床が崩れ――
079.csv::275.translated_text:
I would&#x27;ve had a key to the front of the
room, but when I reached for the treasure
chest in the corridor, the floor collapsed...
079.csv::275.speaker: Pamela

079.csv::276.source_text:
グリッテン砦正門が開き、
補給担当のジョナスが砦に配属されました
079.csv::276.translated_text:
The Fort Gritten main gate has opened, and
Supply Officer Jonas has been assigned there.
079.csv::276.speaker: Leo

079.csv::279.source_text:
&quot;書き置き&quot;
もし――ここまで探しに来てくれたなら
会いたいな
丘の上、崩れた教会で待ってるから
079.csv::279.translated_text:
Note: &quot;If you&#x27;ve come all this way to find
me, I want to see you.
I&#x27;ll be waiting at the ruined church
on top of the hill.&quot;
079.csv::279.speaker: Leo

079.csv::280.source_text: 封鎖エリア《メルゴダ護政区》開放
079.csv::280.translated_text:
The restricted area &quot;Mergoda Security
District&quot; has been unsealed.
079.csv::280.speaker: Leo

079.csv::284.source_text: 赤色症に効く薬草を入手した
079.csv::284.translated_text:
Obtained the herb effective
against red fever.
079.csv::284.speaker: Mayleaf

079.csv::286.source_text:
澄んだ青い光を秘めた石の欠片
&quot;竜の泪&quot;を見つけた
079.csv::286.speaker: Joseph

079.csv::316.source_text:
壁に文字が刻まれている――
&quot;高貴なるサマラの指に輝きし光
我が心を魅了し、支配する光
輝きから逃れんと塔に身を隠すが
我が思いはひとときも離れず&quot;
079.csv::316.translated_text:
There are inscriptions on the wall: &quot;On the
noble Samara&#x27;s fingers, a radiant light
shines, enchanting and ruling our hearts,
Though I hide in the tower to escape the
radiance, My thoughts never
stray for a moment.&quot;
079.csv::316.speaker: Joseph

079.csv::317.source_text:
床に文字が刻まれている――
&quot;探究と秘密を愛する者よ
ここより北の洞窟で待つ
高貴なるサマラの指に輝きし光
人の目に余る煌めきサマラに帰るべし&quot;
079.csv::317.translated_text:
There are inscriptions on the floor: &quot;O
seeker of exploration and secrets; I await
in the cave north from here, where the
radiant light shines on the noble fingers of
Samara. Return to Samara with a brilliance
beyond human eyes.&quot;
079.csv::317.speaker: Joseph

079.csv::318.source_text:
石棺に文字が刻まれている――
&quot;我が欲望は光に焼かれて人外となる
探究と秘密を愛する者よ、どうか我が身に平穏を
高貴なるサマラの指に輝きし光
人の目に余る煌めきサマラに帰るべし&quot;
079.csv::318.translated_text:
Inscriptions are carved into the stone
coffin: &quot;My desire is scorched by the light
and becomes inhuman.
O lover of inquiry and secrets,
please grant me peace.
The light that shone upon the noble Samara’s
fingers— A radiance too brilliant for human
eyes—must return to Samara.&quot;
079.csv::318.speaker: Joseph

079.csv::319.source_text:
冒険者の遺したメッセージとは
関係のない落書きのようだ――
079.csv::319.translated_text:
Looks like graffiti that has nothing to do
with the message left by the adventurer...
079.csv::319.speaker: Joseph

079.csv::320.source_text: 初代王サマラの指輪を入手した
079.csv::320.translated_text:
You have obtained the ring of the
first king, Samara.
079.csv::320.speaker: Joseph

079.csv::388.source_text: ――鋭いもので削られた跡がある
079.csv::388.translated_text:
—Marks of having been scraped by
a sharp object.
079.csv::388.speaker: Carrie

079.csv::425.source_text:
この中ではこれはハズレだろう――
と、分かっていてつい調べてしまった！
079.csv::425.translated_text:
This one is probably a bust—
but you just couldn&#x27;t help checking it!
079.csv::425.speaker: Sonel

079.csv::426.source_text:
かなり期待して調べたのだが――
ただのデカいカボチャのようだ
どうやってここまで投げ込んだのだろうか？
079.csv::426.translated_text:
You had high hopes while checking it, but—
it&#x27;s just a large pumpkin. 
You wonder how it was tossed here?
079.csv::426.speaker: Sonel

079.csv::422.source_text:
エルマーにもらった張り紙だ
これで火薬庫にいる見張りを
櫓の上へ移動させることができる
079.csv::422.translated_text:
A notice from Elmer. It will help move the
guard in the powder magazine to
the top of the tower.
079.csv::422.speaker: Sonel

079.csv::428.source_text:
熟成を通り越して完全に腐っている――
これはこれで嫌だが
探しているものとは違うようだ
079.csv::428.translated_text:
It&#x27;s completely rotted beyond ripeness— it&#x27;s
unpleasant, but not what you&#x27;re looking for.
079.csv::428.speaker: Sonel

079.csv::429.source_text:
奥の方から火薬の臭いがする
向こう側は火薬庫のようだ
079.csv::429.translated_text:
You smell gunpowder from the back.
Looks like a powder magazine over there.
079.csv::429.speaker: Sonel

079.csv::432.source_text: 敵に見つかってしまった！
079.csv::432.speaker: Sonel

079.csv::437.source_text:
小型の投石器が置かれている――
複数を相手にするのは無理だろう
079.csv::437.translated_text:
A small catapult is set up here—
it&#x27;s not suited for dealing with many foes.
079.csv::437.speaker: Sonel

079.csv::453.source_text: ツボの中に丸められた紙が入っている――
079.csv::453.translated_text:
There is a rolled up piece of paper
in the jar...
079.csv::453.speaker: Sonel

079.csv::455.source_text:
何かについて書かれた本だ――
つい最近誰かが読んだ痕跡がある
079.csv::455.translated_text:
It&#x27;s a book about something...
There are traces of someone
reading it just recently.
079.csv::455.speaker: Sonel
